import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MODULUS = 1000000007;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int total_points = scanner.nextInt();
        int factor_value = scanner.nextInt();

        int[] k_array = new int[total_points];
        for (int i = 0; i < total_points; i++) {
            k_array[i] = (int)((long)factor_value * i % total_points);
        }

        if (factor_value == 0) {
            System.out.println(powMod(total_points, total_points - 1, MODULUS));
            return;
        } else if (factor_value == 1) {
            System.out.println(powMod(total_points, total_points, MODULUS));
            return;
        }

        int[] visited_list = new int[total_points];
        int[] cycle_count_list = new int[total_points + 1]; // size up to total_points
        long answer_value = 1;

        for (int start_idx = 0; start_idx < total_points; start_idx++) {
            if (visited_list[start_idx] != 0) {
                continue;
            }
            int cycle_length = 1;
            int current_node = start_idx;
            visited_list[current_node] = 1;
            while (visited_list[k_array[current_node]] == 0) {
                current_node = k_array[current_node];
                visited_list[current_node] = 1;
                cycle_length++;
            }
            cycle_count_list[cycle_length]++;
        }

        for (int size = 2; size < total_points; size++) {
            if (cycle_count_list[size] != 0) {
                long total_size = size * cycle_count_list[size] + 1;
                answer_value = (answer_value * powMod(total_size, cycle_count_list[size], MODULUS)) % MODULUS;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(answer_value);
        scanner.close();
    }

    private static long powMod(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        long cur = base % mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * cur) % mod;
            }
            cur = (cur * cur) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
